title: Astro Portal session event payload: mount_parked
description: A park the person asked of the mount: `requested` — the command was sent; `parked` — the mount then reported it parked; `refused` — the mount refused it itself. Parking is never done by the application on its own, so this event always follows a gesture. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

reason.description: Optional, with `outcome: refused`: a short machine code of the cause (`below_horizon`, `parked`, `not_aligned`, `zenith`…), never a sentence.

protocol.description: Optional: the mount's protocol as the application names it (`LX200`, `Alpaca`, `INDI`, `SynScan`, `iOptron`, `NexStar`).
